notes.subject: ורבה העזובה
notes.rationale: Go ka bala gore 'go tlošwa go tla ba golo' (go bala ka boima) goba 'dilo tše di tlošitšwego di tla ba dintši'; KJV 'great forsaking' kgathanong le ASV 'forsaken places be many'.

notes.subject: go tlošwa-mo-go-kgolo
notes.rationale: העזובה ke maina a go tlošwa ga badudi; go tlošwa-mo-go-kgolo go boloka sebopego sa leina.

translation: gomme Yahwe a tlo ntšha ⟨את⟩ motho kgauswi-ntle, gomme go tlo ba le go tlošwa-mo-go-kgolo gare ga lefase.

tokens.gloss: gomme go tlo ba le go tlošwa-mo-go-kgolo
